featureCounts 2.1.1 (Subread 2.1.1): featureCounts
Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (LICENSE in this folder). Built with zlib 1.3.1 (LICENSE.zlib); the loader is
Emscripten's runtime, with a small change of the genomics-wasm port (MIT and NCSA: LICENSE.emscripten).
THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt lists them.
Upstream source: https://subread.sourceforge.net/ (subread-2.1.1-source.tar.gz – in ../../../licenses/sources/)

Compiled to WebAssembly by the genomics-wasm project (https://github.com/comparativechrono/genomics-wasm,
commit e8c3e15): Emscripten 3.1.64, with threads (pthreads in shared WebAssembly memory). The module
(featurecounts.mjs, featurecounts.wasm) is used here as that project built it: the page runs each command in
a worker of its own (assets/js/threads-worker.mjs), which needs a cross-origin isolated page. Everything
needed to build it again is described in ../../../licenses/genomics-wasm-build/.

Changes to the source (tools/featurecounts/browser.patch there): at most four counting threads (-T 1 to 4);
standard file functions in place of Linux's fopen64; integer formats of the right widths; the counters of
junctions and splice sites stop the program (status 2) rather than overflow on 32-bit WebAssembly. Counting
is unchanged.

In the workbench's terminal, featureCounts -T N (N > 4) counts on four threads, with a note. Emscripten's
note "warning: unsupported syscall: __syscall_prlimit64" (featureCounts asks for its limit of open files) is
left out of the messages.

Checked against featureCounts 2.1.1 built natively from the same source (genomics-wasm's comparison: 30 of
30 cases with human and yeast RNA-seq alignments; and in the workbench with the example data): the same
count tables and summaries (apart from the command line in the table's first line).
